title: Dominant Execution Uncertainty Fence
problem: Indirect retry paths in Supervisor and Reconciler can trigger duplicate task execution during network or worker timeout.
evidence: Verified in WS2 (EXP-WS2-COMP-001) and WS4 (EXP-WS4-CRASH-001). Mutant MUT-03 killed.
proposed_change_boundary: Insert DispatcherUncertaintyFence as a gate before any dispatch, retry, or fallback invocation.
migration_impact: Compatible with existing journals; uncertain tasks tagged on restart.
rollback: Feature flag disable falls back to direct reconciliation.
independent_verifier: ResultCustoms verifying zero duplicate execution receipts.
known_risks: Tasks in degraded networks may remain quarantined until explicit liveness confirmation.
stop_condition: Any duplicate execution observed in integration test suite.
